description.en:
Reserves a tornado hazard on the match pitch and returns its handle. The tornado is not active yet: place and switch it on with CMND_BTL_ACTIVE_TORNADE, and check it with CMND_BTL_IS_ACTIVE_TORNADE.

The match keeps a table of pitch objects. Tornadoes, bumpers and flippers are three kinds of entry in it (CMND_BTL_REG_BUMPER and CMND_BTL_REG_FLIPPER reserve the other two kinds). The hazard maps call these from their ScMapInit function.

Handle (index) of the reserved tornado in the pitch-object table.
null if the match system is not ready.

examples.case: Reserving tornadoes when a hazard map loads
